Пользователь спросил: «Что не так с передачей задач между агентами?» Напиши ему ответ на русском.
protected: the prose is Russian: handoff, blob, busy, waiters, narration, idle and progress channel are not left as English words outside code formatting

three defects kept: the task is handed over as one unstructured text; a crash of the child process is not reported through the progress channel; turning the commentary off also turns off delivery of the final report
after a crash the busy flag is cleared and the waiting agents are woken
the 30 s idle timeout is not turned into a fourth defect
no invented cause, file or fix
